description: Crypto liquidation data, funding radar and options for agents. Live perp liquidation tape from Bybit, OKX and Binance, liquidation heatmap by price level, 15-minute cascade forecast, cross-venue funding z-scores, Deribit options IV and dealer gamma, a one-call market regime read, and stock and commodity perps ranked by funding. Pay per call in USDC over x402 on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc. No API key.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
